pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free Plan: $0/month, includes 5 AI tasks per month… Plus Plan: $8/month per user, includes 200 AI tasks per month. When billed annually, the Plus Plan is $6/month per user. Pro Plan: $79/month + $8/month per user, includes 1,000 AI tasks per month."

sources.title: Rows Pricing Plans: Free, Plus, Pro and Enterprise

plans.name: Pro
plans.quota: 1,000 AI tasks per month, plus $8 per user

nl.tagline: Spreadsheet met ingebouwde AI en live datakoppelingen
nl.description: Rows is een online spreadsheet met een AI-analist die data samenvat, grafieken maakt en tabellen transformeert, plus koppelingen met bronnen als Google Analytics, HubSpot en Stripe voor live rapportages.

en.tagline: Spreadsheet with built-in AI and live data connections
en.description: Rows is an online spreadsheet with an AI analyst that summarises data, builds charts and transforms tables, plus integrations with sources such as Google Analytics, HubSpot and Stripe for live reporting.
bestFor: Marketing and sales reports with live data
Teams moving from Excel to the web
notFor: Very large datasets or complex BI
